en.title: The Veil of Star Frost and the Midnight Waltz
en.premise: In the sleepless city of Etelna, where the sun never rises, nobles don jeweled gowns and revel in endless ballrooms. A fallen duchess, a clockmaker who has lost his memory, and an exiled prince each bear a different destiny. Their paths collide amid a vast conspiracy that could decide the city’s fate. They encounter the legendary "Final Train"—will it herald the city’s demise or hold the key to its rebirth?

zh.title: 星霜之幕与午夜圆舞（华尔兹）
zh.premise: 在永不升起太阳的无眠之城埃特尔纳，贵族们披上镶嵌宝石的华服，沉醉于无尽的舞会。没落的公爵小姐、失忆的钟表匠以及流亡中的王子，三人各自背负不同命运，却在决定城市命运的巨大阴谋中交错相遇。他们所遇到的，传说中的『终极列车』——它是预示这座城市终结的信号，还是通往重生的钥匙？
